columns.name: session_id
columns.description: Session ID.

columns.name: dataset_version
columns.description: Schema version the session's task logic declared.

columns.name: data_contract_version
columns.description: Version of the data-contract library that read the session.

columns.name: packaging_version
columns.description: Version of the packaging library that produced these tables.

columns.name: curriculum_enabled
columns.description: Whether the subject was on-curriculum. Null where the session records no trainer state, which is not an error: curriculum tracking is optional.

columns.name: curriculum_name
columns.description: Curriculum the trainer state named.

columns.name: curriculum_stage_name
columns.description: Stage the trainer state named.

rules.message: a curriculum stage is named with no curriculum to place it in
rules.sql:
SELECT session_id
FROM vr_foraging.sessions
WHERE curriculum_stage_name IS NOT NULL
  AND curriculum_name IS NULL

rules.message: the session reports as on-curriculum but names no curriculum
rules.sql:
SELECT session_id
FROM vr_foraging.sessions
WHERE curriculum_enabled
  AND curriculum_name IS NULL

columns.name: session_id
columns.description: Session ID.

columns.name: site_id
columns.description: The site these concentrations were set for.

columns.name: odor_channel_index
columns.description: Which olfactometer channel, as an offset into the rig's channel list.

columns.name: concentration
columns.description: Concentration commanded on this channel. Zero where the channel was not used: the source emits one value per channel whether or not an odor is on it, so a missing row is a missing channel rather than a silent one.

rules.message: sites carry different numbers of odor channels, so the channel list is not the rig's
rules.sql:
SELECT session_id, site_id, n
FROM (
  SELECT session_id, site_id, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM vr_foraging.site_odors
  GROUP BY session_id, site_id
) AS t
WHERE n <> (
  SELECT MAX(n)
  FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM vr_foraging.site_odors
    GROUP BY session_id, site_id
  ) AS derived_1
)

rules.message: a site's odor channels are not 0..n-1, so the index does not address the rig's list
rules.sql:
SELECT session_id, site_id
FROM (
  SELECT session_id, site_id, MAX(odor_channel_index) AS hi, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM vr_foraging.site_odors
  GROUP BY session_id, site_id
) AS derived_1
WHERE hi <> n - 1

rules.message: a concentration falls outside 0-100%
rules.sql:
SELECT session_id, site_id, odor_channel_index, concentration
FROM vr_foraging.site_odors
WHERE concentration < 0
  OR concentration > 100

columns.name: session_id
columns.description: Session ID.

columns.name: interval_kind
columns.description: Always `vr_foraging.sites`. Carries `core.intervals.interval_kind` as part of the shared key, so the reference to `core.intervals` covers that table's whole key. Not a discriminator: it resolves nothing a consumer of this row does not already know.

columns.name: site_id
columns.description: The site, and the interval it occupies in core. The source numbers sites from 0 within a session and uses that number as the site's identity, so no separate site_index is carried.

columns.name: site_label
columns.description: What kind of site this is, in the task's own words (RewardSite, InterSite, ...).

columns.name: patch_label
columns.description: Patch type this site belongs to.

columns.name: start_position
columns.description: Where the site begins along the virtual corridor.

columns.name: length
columns.description: How far the site extends.

columns.name: friction
columns.description: Friction in force over the site, carried forward from the last friction change.

columns.name: odor_onset_tick
columns.description: When odor reached the animal. Null where no odor was delivered.

columns.name: choice_cue_tick
columns.description: The choice (stop) cue. Null where no choice occurred, which is what makes it the has_choice the source carries separately.

columns.name: reward_onset_tick
columns.description: When water was delivered. Null where none was, which is the source's has_reward.

columns.name: last_stop_tick
columns.description: The last stop before the choice cue. The source calls this last_stop_time because NWB reserves stop_time for an interval's end; here the interval's end is in core and the name is free.

columns.name: reward_amount
columns.description: Water delivered.

columns.name: reward_probability
columns.description: Reward probability at delivery. Null where the reward was not sampled. No unit is declared: the model says percentage for a field named probability, and which of 0-1 or 0-100 is stored has not been checked against data.

columns.name: reward_available
columns.description: Water left in the patch at delivery. Null where the reward was not sampled.

columns.name: has_forced_rewards
columns.description: Whether the experimenter triggered a reward inside the site. The times are in the event stream; this says only that at least one is there.

columns.name: has_waited_reward_delay
columns.description: Whether the animal held through the reward delay. Null where no choice occurred.

columns.name: velocity_at_last_stop
columns.description: Velocity at the sample closest to last_stop_tick. Null where that is null.

columns.name: patch_index
columns.description: Which patch of the session this site is in, from 0.

columns.name: block_index
columns.description: Which block of the session this site is in, from 0.

columns.name: site_index_in_patch
columns.description: Position among the sites of this patch, from 0.

columns.name: site_index_in_block
columns.description: Position among the sites of this block, from 0.

columns.name: site_index_by_type
columns.description: Position among the session's sites sharing this site_label, from 0.

columns.name: site_index_in_patch_by_type
columns.description: Position among this patch's sites sharing this site_label, from 0.

columns.name: site_index_in_block_by_type
columns.description: Position among this block's sites sharing this site_label, from 0.

columns.name: patch_index_by_type
columns.description: Position among the session's patches sharing this patch_label, from 0.

columns.name: patch_index_in_block
columns.description: Position among this block's patches, from 0.

columns.name: patch_index_in_block_by_type
columns.description: Position among this block's patches sharing this patch_label, from 0.

rules.message: site_index_in_patch does not match the order it claims to record
rules.sql:
SELECT session_id, site_id, site_index_in_patch
FROM (
  SELECT session_id, site_id, site_index_in_patch,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id, patch_index ORDER BY site_id) - 1 AS expected
  FROM vr_foraging.sites
) AS derived_1
WHERE site_index_in_patch <> expected

rules.message: site_index_in_block does not match the order it claims to record
rules.sql:

FROM (
  SELECT session_id, site_id, patch_index_in_block,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id, block_index ORDER BY patch_index) - 1 AS expected
  FROM vr_foraging.sites
) AS derived_1
WHERE patch_index_in_block <> expected

rules.message: water was delivered before the choice cue, so the reward delay is negative
rules.sql:
SELECT session_id, site_id, choice_cue_tick, reward_onset_tick
FROM vr_foraging.sites
WHERE choice_cue_tick IS NOT NULL
  AND reward_onset_tick IS NOT NULL
  AND reward_onset_tick < choice_cue_tick

rules.message: the last stop is recorded after the choice cue it is supposed to precede
rules.sql:
SELECT session_id, site_id, last_stop_tick, choice_cue_tick
FROM vr_foraging.sites
WHERE last_stop_tick IS NOT NULL
  AND choice_cue_tick IS NOT NULL
  AND last_stop_tick > choice_cue_tick

rules.message: a choice cue is recorded with no preceding stop, which the parse requires
rules.sql:
SELECT session_id, site_id
FROM vr_foraging.sites
WHERE choice_cue_tick IS NOT NULL
  AND last_stop_tick IS NULL

rules.message: a site with no choice carries values the source only fills in when one occurred
rules.sql:
SELECT session_id, site_id
FROM vr_foraging.sites
WHERE choice_cue_tick IS NULL
  AND (
    reward_probability IS NOT NULL
    OR reward_available IS NOT NULL
    OR has_waited_reward_delay IS NOT NULL
  )

rules.message: a velocity at the last stop is recorded where there is no last stop to take it at
rules.sql:
SELECT session_id, site_id
FROM vr_foraging.sites
WHERE velocity_at_last_stop IS NOT NULL
  AND last_stop_tick IS NULL

rules.message: a patch's sites are not consecutive, so patch_index does not describe the traversal
rules.sql:
SELECT session_id, patch_index
FROM (
  SELECT session_id, patch_index,
    CAST(MAX(site_id) AS DECIMAL(38,0)) - CAST(MIN(site_id) AS DECIMAL(38,0)) + 1 AS span,
    COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM vr_foraging.sites
  GROUP BY session_id, patch_index
) AS derived_1
WHERE span <> n

rules.message: a block's sites are not consecutive, so block_index does not describe the traversal
rules.sql:
SELECT session_id, block_index
FROM (
  SELECT session_id, block_index,
    CAST(MAX(site_id) AS DECIMAL(38,0)) - CAST(MIN(site_id) AS DECIMAL(38,0)) + 1 AS span,
    COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM vr_foraging.sites
  GROUP BY session_id, block_index
) AS derived_1
WHERE span <> n

rules.message: a patch spans more than one block, which patch_index_in_block cannot express
rules.sql:
SELECT session_id, patch_index
FROM (
  SELECT session_id, patch_index, COUNT(DISTINCT block_index) AS blocks
  FROM vr_foraging.sites
  GROUP BY session_id, patch_index
) AS derived_1
WHERE blocks > 1

rules.message: a patch carries more than one patch_label, so patch_index_by_type is undefined
rules.sql:
SELECT session_id, patch_index
FROM (
  SELECT session_id, patch_index, COUNT(DISTINCT patch_label) AS labels
  FROM vr_foraging.sites
  GROUP BY session_id, patch_index
) AS derived_1
WHERE labels > 1
